examples.en: He got a good grade in math.
What is your assessment of the situation?

note: School grades run from 1 to 5; «петица» is a five, the top grade.

examples.en: Don't forget your passport!
My passport expired last month.

tips: The everyday domestic document is the лична карта (a plastic ID card); пасош is the passport for traveling abroad.

examples.en: Do you have a pet?
The youngest son is the favorite of the whole family.

tips: A pet is a «кућни љубимац»: «Мој љубимац се разболео» (My pet got sick). A vet is ветеринар; «код ветеринара» means at the vet's.

examples.en: The little kitty is sleeping on the couch.
Come here, kitty!

tips: Маца and цица are both an endearing «kitty». From the proverb: доћи ће маца на вратанца - he will come back asking for a favor himself.

examples.sr: Која је [у̀да̄љено̄ст] од Београда до Новог Сада?
examples.en: What is the distance from Belgrade to Novi Sad?
He watched us from a distance.
The police chief made a statement.
Understood, chief!
School starts on the first of September.
In September we go to the seaside.
Tomorrow I have an audition for a part.
She passed the audition on her first try!
The male is much bigger than the female.
Among lions, the male has a mane.
This word comes from Turkish.
My family comes from Montenegro.
The police squad arrived at the scene.
He served in a special unit.
Clap to the rhythm of the music.

examples.sr: Животни [рѝтам] у великом граду је брз.
examples.en: The pace of life in a big city is fast.
The car has no damage at all.
Doctors found damage to the liver.
Since she left, I feel an emptiness.
Fill in the blanks in the text.
The new treatment is giving good results.
I didn't deserve such treatment.

tips: Used for a medical, cosmetic or spa treatment (третман лица, a facial). «Процедура» does not fit this sense: it means only a sequence of steps, e.g. a divorce procedure.

examples.en: The team suffered a heavy defeat.
He never admits defeat.
Surprise is a key element of our plan.
Oxygen is a chemical element.
The sporting goods store is downtown.
In the evening he only watches the sports channel.
My phone screen cracked.
Children spend too much time in front of a screen.
This is a well-known Italian brand.
She only buys expensive brands.
I was pleasantly surprised.
Why are you so surprised?
We watched a tennis match until midnight.
He lost the match in three sets.
The admiral ordered the attack.
Understood, Admiral!
The negotiations have been going on for months.

examples.sr: Обе стране су селе за сто за [прѐговоре].
examples.en: Both sides sat down at the negotiating table.
That writer has a rich imagination.
It's just his fantasy.

tips: Фантазија also works as praise, like «fantastic»: то је једна фантазија! - that's just fantastic.

examples.en: Learn the multiplication table by tomorrow.
I memorized the car's license plate number.

note: «регистарске таблице» are a car's license plates
tips: Таблица is not only a table or chart but also a car's license plate (регистарска таблица).

examples.en: The case reached the Supreme Court.
He is the supreme commander of the army.
My great-grandfather was a peasant.
Don't behave like a hick!

tips: In slang «сељак» means a hick or a boor. Even ruder is «сељобер»: what Belgraders call newcomers who bring rural manners with them.
Сељак is a rural resident, a peasant, and neutral. Сељачина is already rude, a «hick». For city people the word can also be mocking.

examples.en: Testing of the new drug takes years.
Tomorrow I'm going for a blood test.
She has been into acting since childhood.
The acting in this film is excellent.
The car hit a tree.
We made a family tree.

tips: Besides «trunk», стабло is a tree as a plant («воћно стабло» - fruit tree) and the stalk of a grass or flower.

examples.en: All this looks suspicious to me.
That man is behaving very suspiciously.

meanings: to pull in, to draw in
forms: увучем, увуку; past увукао; impf. увлачити

examples.en: Pull in your stomach in the picture!

examples.sr: Не желим да те [у̀вучем] у ово.
examples.en: I don't want to drag you into this.
I want a dress like the one she has.
He isn't the way I thought he was.
He is my closest co-worker.
The police are looking for his accomplices.
This is a new method of treatment.
His methods are a bit strange.

examples.sr: Знам да звучи [су̏лудо], али верујем му.
examples.en: I know it sounds insane, but I believe him.
Apartment prices are insanely high.

examples.sr: Видео сам је са неком високом [пла̀вушом].
examples.en: I saw him with some tall blonde.
His sister is a natural blonde.

note: «плав» means both blond (of hair) and blue

examples.sr: Направио је [ско̏к] у воду са стене.
examples.en: He jumped into the water from a cliff.
There was a sudden jump in prices.
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love.
The child had measles.

note: «мале богиње» is measles, «овчије богиње» is chickenpox

examples.sr: Сателит је сада у [о̀рбити] око Земље.
examples.en: The satellite is now in orbit around the Earth.
The rocket successfully reached orbit.
Wipe your feet before you come in.
I accidentally deleted an important file.
She didn't drink coffee during her pregnancy.
She bought a pregnancy test.
The party was great!
Extra services cost extra.
Someone set off the alarm.
How do I activate the new card?
Create a profile on the site.
Take a photo of me from the side.
After the match, total chaos broke out.
That's utter nonsense.
They live in complete harmony with nature.
We work in accordance with the law.
Artificial intelligence is changing the world.
He has above-average intelligence.

tips: Интелигенција means intellect: вештачка интелигенција - artificial intelligence. «The intelligentsia» as a social class is not the main meaning.

examples.en: What connects these two victims?
This bridge links two parts of the city.

examples.sr: Купили смо нови [на̏мешта̄ј] за дневну собу.
examples.en: We bought new furniture for the living room.
We gave the old furniture to the neighbors.

meanings: to veer off, to run off (the road)

examples.en: The plane landed on time.

examples.sr: Ауто је [слѐтео] с пута у јарак.
examples.en: The car ran off the road into a ditch.
Before leaving, he dropped by to say goodbye.
I beg your forgiveness.

examples.sr: Породица ми је на првом месту, то је [приорѝте̄т].
examples.en: Family comes first for me, it's a priority.
Passenger safety is our top priority.
This is the complete collection of his books.
In the morning she makes a full breakfast for everyone.
Our neighbor is a real oddball.

examples.sr: Сви у школи мисле да сам [чу̀да̄к].
examples.en: Everyone at school thinks I'm a weirdo.
We have a little house in the country.
The dog sleeps in its doghouse.
Give me the hammer and a few nails.
He hit his finger with a hammer.
That song is the biggest hit of the year.
Their new film is a real hit.
A wide avenue leads to the main square.

examples.sr: Живели су на Петој [авѐнији] у Њујорку.
examples.en: They lived on Fifth Avenue in New York.

meanings: to pass, to go by (of time)

examples.en: The Danube flows through Belgrade.
Time flies when you're happy.
When you're sick, drink plenty of fluids.
There's some green liquid on the floor.
He grew up on a ranch in Texas.
They bought a ranch with horses.
It was a frightening sight.
This statistic is frightening.
The image was taken from a satellite.
They launched a new satellite.
Playing video games takes up a lot of his time.
Children need space to play.
A bee stung me.
She is busy as a bee.
What is the name of this street?
I forgot the title of that movie.
Grandpa welcomed us on the doorstep.
He has a very low pain threshold.

note: the city of Prague is «Праг» in Serbian

examples.en: At that time he was at the peak of his career.
The climax of the evening was the fireworks.
Take as much as you need.

examples.sr: Нисам знао да ће доћи [онолѝко̄] људи.
examples.en: I didn't know that many people would come.
A swarm of bees attacked us.
My head is swarming with thoughts.
You acted wisely.
Spend your money wisely.

meanings: to have a command of (+ instr.)

examples.en: The king reigned for forty years.
He has an excellent command of English.

note: + instr.: владати језиком - to have a command of a language

examples.en: Don't worry, this is a routine check.

examples.sr: На граници је била детаљна [про̏вера] пасоша.
examples.en: There was a thorough passport check at the border.
Son, I'm proud of you.
Parents are proud of their children.

note: + instr.: поносити се неким - to be proud of someone

examples.en: The soldiers waited for the order to attack.
Do you know the Ten Commandments?
The host entertained us well.
Serbia is the host of the championship.

forms: онесвестим се, онесвесте се; impf. онесвешћивати се

examples.en: She fainted on the bus from the heat.

examples.sr: Мислио сам да ћу се [онѐсвестити] од страха.
examples.en: I thought I would faint from fear.
I concluded from that that he is lying.
The two companies signed a contract.
Put the plate on the table.
He ate a whole bowl of soup.
You should eat more vegetables.
We bought fresh vegetables at the market.
They laid the foundation for a new house.
Trust is the foundation of every relationship.
This virus can be deadly.
He dealt him a fatal blow.

forms: састанем се, састану се; impf. састајати се

examples.sr: Хајде да се [са̀станемо] сутра у десет.
examples.en: Let's meet tomorrow at ten.
The government will meet on Monday.
It was a magical evening.
He believes the stone has magic powers.
Open a can of tuna.
On the road we ate only canned food.
I've been learning Spanish for two years.
I love Spanish cuisine.
Draw the curtains, the sun is bothering me.
At the end of the play the curtain came down.
I'm not bored, on the contrary!

examples.sr: Он није лош, [на̏протӣв], веома је добар.
examples.en: He's not bad, on the contrary, he's very good.

note: only «on the contrary»; for «opposite» (place) use «преко пута»

examples.en: Thank you for your understanding.
There is little understanding between us.
He planned an escape from prison.
Running away from problems is not a solution.

examples.sr: На залеђеном путу потребан је велики [о̏пре̄з].
examples.en: Great caution is needed on an icy road.
He opened the door cautiously.
The Eiffel Tower is the symbol of Paris.
The princess lived in a high tower.

examples.sr: Ову торту сам [спе̏ција̄лно] за тебе направила.
examples.en: I made this cake specially for you.
Nothing special, we just watched a movie.
She sang superbly last night.
This is exceptionally important to us.

forms: печем, пеку; past пекао; pf. испећи

examples.en: Grandma bakes cookies every Sunday.
The sun is really burning today.

tips: It covers both baking and roasting: пећи хлеб, пећи месо, пећи колаче (bread, meat, cakes).
For rakija, «пеку» is the word for making it (distilling): пећи ракију. «Кувана ракија» is a different thing: rakija heated with sugar («шумадијски чај»).

examples.en: Where did you get that bruise on your arm?
After the fall I was covered in bruises.
He is the leader of a mafia clan.

examples.sr: Цео њихов [кла̑н] је дошао на свадбу.
examples.en: Their whole clan came to the wedding.
The atmosphere at the meeting was tense.
Why are you so tense today?
Sit next to me.
Their house is by the river.
This wine is excellent.
His mother is an excellent cook.

forms: разведем се, разведу се; past развео се; impf. разводити се

examples.sr: [Ра̀звели] су се после десет година брака.
examples.en: They got divorced after ten years of marriage.
I think they are going to get divorced.
He gave me some friendly advice.
We talked in a friendly and open way.

forms: доспем, доспеју; past доспео; impf. доспевати

examples.en: How did you end up here?
The letter ended up in the wrong hands.
This area has a mild climate.
Turn on the AC, it's so hot!

tips: Feminine noun: клима is both the climate and, colloquially, an air conditioner: «Упали климу».
In everyday speech клима means an air conditioner: «Укључи климу». The climate is also клима, and context tells which is meant.

examples.en: India used to be a British colony.
There is a big colony of ants in the yard.
Beans with sausage is a traditional dish.
On Fridays we always cook beans at our place.

tips: Пасуљ is the national bean dish. «Боранија» is green beans and «грашак» is peas.
«Пасуљ» is not only the beans but also a thick soup made from them with smoked meat, a winter dish: «тањир пасуља».

examples.sr: Не може да заспи без свог плишаног [ме̏де].
examples.en: He can't fall asleep without his teddy bear.
Come on, teddy bear, don't be mad.
Tomorrow I'm going to the dentist.
My brother is a dentist.
The concert is in the large hall.
The sports hall was full.

forms: поклапам се, поклапају се; pf. поклопити се

examples.sr: Његова прича се не [по̀клапа] са њеном.
examples.en: His story doesn't match hers.
The fingerprints match.
I had a banana for breakfast.
Buy a kilo of bananas too.
The salesman gave me my change.

examples.sr: Ради као [про̀да̄вац] у радњи са одећом.
examples.en: He works as a salesman in a clothing store.

meanings: to dig up, to dig out

examples.en: The dog dug up a bone in the yard.
We dug a deep hole.

tips: «Ископати очи» means to gouge out someone's eyes. «Ископати се» is figurative: to get out of trouble, to scramble out.

examples.en: We came across an obstacle on the way.
Age is no barrier to love.
What is the meaning of this word?

examples.sr: Тај датум има посебно [зна́че̄ње] за мене.
examples.en: This date has a special meaning for me.
Our victory is all thanks to you.
He received a medal for his services.
We visited an old castle on the hill.
The princess lives in a castle.

note: a door lock is «брава»; «замка» is a trap

examples.en: I looked for you everywhere!
There are stores like that everywhere.
He is a traitor and a liar!
Traitors don't deserve forgiveness.
A little bird is singing on the windowsill.

examples.sr: Рекла ми је једна [пти̏чица] да се жениш.
examples.en: A little bird told me you're getting married.
This is a first-class restaurant.
He is a top athlete.
The dog is loyal to its owner.
She stayed faithful to him to the end.
I was born in June.
The school year ends at the end of June.
This discovery is of great importance.
Don't attach too much importance to it.
I have five extra kilos.

examples.sr: Осећам се као [ви́шак] у овом друштву.
examples.en: I feel superfluous in this company.

examples.sr: Сав новац иде у [фо̏нд] за болесну децу.
examples.en: All the money goes to a fund for sick children.
The pension fund doesn't have enough money.

meanings: to wait until, to live to see

examples.en: I'll meet you at the airport.
I could hardly wait for the weekend.

note: «дочекати Нову годину» means to see in the New Year
tips: Used not only for guests but also for an event or holiday: «дочекати Нову годину», «дочекати госте на Божић». Impf. дочекивати.

Дочекати can mean to receive guests so that they are fed and entertained: «лепо су нас дочекали». It also means «to wait until»: «једва су дочекали». «Дочек Нове године» is the New Year's Eve celebration.

forms: gen. посетиоца; pl. посетиоци, gen. pl. посетилаца

examples.sr: Музеј је прошле године имао много [посѐтилаца].
examples.en: The museum had many visitors last year.
Visitors are not allowed to take photos.
We walked along the shore.
Old trees grow along the road.
He suffered a great trauma in childhood.
He is still recovering from the trauma.

note: a physical injury is more often «повреда»

examples.en: My husband isn't very romantic.
He prepared a romantic candlelit dinner.
I was just curious, nothing more.
Children are curious by nature.
Come here, give me a hug.
She fell asleep in his arms.
What do you want in return?

examples.sr: Помогао ми је, а ја сам га [за̏узвра̄т] частио ручком.
examples.en: He helped me, and in return I treated him to lunch.
There was a professional photographer at the wedding.
He works as a photographer for a magazine.
The interior of the house is nicely furnished.
He lives in the interior of Serbia.

forms: gen. листа; pl. листови; coll. лишће

examples.en: Give me a sheet of paper.
That newspaper comes out every day.

tips: A homonym: лист is also the calf of the leg; «бол у листу» is calf pain. Compare «коса» (hair / scythe) and «пас» (dog / belt).

examples.en: He lifts heavy weights at the gym.
I usually withdraw money at an ATM.
What's your nickname?

examples.sr: У школи су му дали [на́димак] Мали.
examples.en: At school they gave him the nickname Little One.

tips: Nicknames are formed from first names and surnames: Александар - Аца, Сале; Светлана - Цеца; Ђаић - Ђајо. It is better to call a person by the name they introduced themselves with.

examples.en: Mom sends you her best regards!
He always greets the neighbors politely.

tips: It does not mean «to congratulate on a holiday»: that is «честитати». It means to greet, to say hello, to pass on regards, and also to salute a flag.
Поздрављати means to pass on regards and say hello; «поздрављати се» means to say hello and goodbye. «Поздрав!» is said both on meeting and on parting.
The verb takes the accusative: «поздрављамо вас». «Поздравити се са» + instr. means to say goodbye: «поздравио се са свима». «Поздрав» is a greeting, «Поздрави своје» means say hi to your family.

examples.en: The rose is my favorite flower.
He picked a flower for her.

note: «цвеће» is flowers in general; «color» is «боја», not «цвет»
tips: Цвет and боја are different words: «цвет» is a single flower (pl. цветови), цвеће is flowers collectively; for «color» only «боја» is used. «Цвеће у саксији» means flowers in a pot.
Only «flower». For the color use боја: «Која је твоја омиљена боја?»

examples.en: This time I really screwed up.
He cheated us out of money.

tips: зезнути се means to make a mistake, to blow it; зезнуто means tricky, complicated: «Зезнуто је наћи добар стан». Зезнути некога means to cheat someone.

examples.en: As a child he often got a beating.
It cuts both ways.

note: «добити батине» means to get a beating

examples.sr: Деца треба да расту у здравом [окру̀жењу].
examples.en: Children should grow up in a healthy environment.

examples.sr: Нико из мог [окру̀жења] то не зна.
examples.en: No one in my circle knows that.
The payment of wages is delayed again.
We're still waiting for the insurance payout.
Can you solve this riddle?

examples.sr: Тај човек је за мене права [за̏гоне̄тка].
examples.en: That man is a real mystery to me.
The robbers escaped with the money.
The police caught the bank robber.
Smoking is strictly forbidden.
Father gave me a stern look.
Fall is my favorite season.

examples.sr: На [је̏се̄н] се селимо у нови стан.
examples.en: In the fall we're moving to a new apartment.

note: feminine: топла јесен; «на јесен» means in the fall
tips: «In the fall» is «на јесен» or «у јесен» (likewise «на пролеће»); «лети» and «зими» take no preposition.

examples.en: The film is based on a true story.

examples.sr: Да ли је то што кажеш [истѝнито]?
examples.en: Is what you're saying true?
You're just a traitor!
Nobody likes traitors.

note: of a man it takes masculine agreement: тај издајица

examples.en: Grandpa was a prisoner of war.
They freed all the prisoners.
He wore a gray suit at the wedding.
The sky is dreary and gray today.
He published a scientific paper on viruses.
I like reading science fiction.
This young player has great potential.
You haven't realized your potential.
For years he was a police informer.
One of us is a snitch.

examples.sr: Мој деда је и даље веома [а̏ктӣван].
examples.en: My grandfather is still very active.
That volcano is still active.
Doctors found a tumor in the lungs.
Luckily, the tumor is benign.
The team won the championship title.
He inherited the title of count.
This question is of great importance.
You don't understand the seriousness of this situation.
It's just an optical illusion.
I have no illusions about him.
The country's economy is growing slowly.
My sister studies economics.

tips: Економија is the economy or economics; for saving or thrift use штедња.

examples.en: Tonight we're decorating the tree.
He always embellishes his stories a little.

examples.sr: Купили смо нову машину за [пра́ње] судова.
examples.en: We bought a new dishwasher.
This shirt needs washing.

note: «машина за прање веша» is a washing machine

examples.en: A real brotherhood formed among the soldiers.
The monks live in a small brotherhood.
Why are you ignoring me?
Just ignore him, he'll get over it.
Two people died in the accident.
Children suffer the most because of the war.
The minister handed in his resignation.
Tomorrow I'm quitting, I've had enough.

note: «дати оставку» means to resign, to quit

examples.en: Our physics teacher is very strict.
He works as a teacher in an elementary school.
Your hair is still wet.
Quick, take off those wet clothes.
Let's meet at Republic Square.
The main square was full of people.

meanings: to blow up, to blow apart
forms: разнесем, разнесу; past разнео; impf. разносити

examples.en: The bomb blew up half the building.
The wind scattered the leaves around the yard.
Grandpa has two goats in the village.
This goat gives a lot of milk.
Belgrade has about two million inhabitants.
All the residents of the building went outside.

examples.sr: Могу ли да разговарам са вама [при̏ва̄тно]?
examples.en: May I speak with you in private?
In his private life, he paints.

examples.sr: Уложили смо много [на̀пора] у овај пројекат.
examples.en: We put a lot of effort into this project.

examples.sr: Пењање уз брдо је велики [на́пор] за њега.
examples.en: Climbing the hill is a big strain for him.
Keep away from that man!
He always avoided trouble.
He never misses a single match.
The roof leaks when it rains.
The pregnancy test is positive.
She is a very positive person.
Behave properly at the table!
The food is decent at that restaurant.
For breakfast I eat eggs and sausages.
Buy half a kilo of dried sausage.
He has a serious sleep disorder.
She is being treated for an anxiety disorder.
Am I pronouncing this word correctly?
You need to eat properly.
What are the dimensions of this room?
This adds a completely new dimension to the problem.
The driver committed a traffic violation.
The referee didn't see the foul.
He lacks self-confidence.
Sports gave her back her confidence.
He has a kidney stone.
He gave his brother a kidney.

tips: «Бели бубрези» is a euphemism for a dish made of animal testicles, not real kidneys. Ordinary kidneys are simply «бубрези».

examples.en: Archaeologists discovered an ancient tomb.
He is buried in the family vault.
The picture has a blue background.

examples.sr: Шта је у [по̀задини] целе ове приче?
examples.en: What is behind this whole story?
Mosquitoes transmit diseases.
Television is broadcasting the match live.
He is very gentle with children.
The baby has delicate skin.
Send me the coordinates of that place.
The pilot received new coordinates.
She bought new panties.

examples.sr: Мали је трчао по кући у [га̀ћицама].
examples.en: The little boy ran around the house in his underpants.
What a relief!

examples.sr: Осетио сам велико [олакша́ње] кад је позвала.
examples.en: I felt great relief when she called.
See you next week.
Next summer we're going to Greece.

note: also the verbal adverb of ићи: «going»
